label: WordPress
summary: WordPress on native PHP-FPM and MariaDB; no containers.
guide: WordPress and its MariaDB database are installed for you; you give no repository. Themes and plugins are managed in WordPress itself.
The database runs on the same container on loopback; wp-config.php is already set up with its credentials.
/wp-admin, /wp-login.php and /xmlrpc.php are only reachable from your own networks.
Outgoing connections are limited to wordpress.org, api.wordpress.org and downloads.wordpress.org.
The database is dumped daily at 02:00 and the last 14 dumps are kept on the container.
